name: tin
lore_descriptor: gray-pewter shine, soft enough to bend with thumb pressure
first_pickup_chronicle: Tin. The metal that made the Bronze Age — too soft alone, but it drinks enchantment like a thirsty thing.
design_notes: Band A light-enchantable metal. Soft and unimpressive raw (mult 0.85) but max_enchant 4 means an early enchanter stacks big bonuses. Sister-archetype to quicksilver — both trade raw damage for enchant ceiling. Fills the F1-15 light-ench gap.
